___README___: THIS IS A SNIPPET, NOT A COMPLETE RULES FILE. DO NOT DEPLOY IT ON ITS OWN.
Realtime Database rules are one JSON tree for the entire database.
Publishing a file that contains only these rules would DELETE the rules
protecting APC's movie night and attractions data.
To install: open the Firebase console -> Realtime Database -> Rules, and
paste the 'jawaiTrip' block below INSIDE your existing top-level 'rules'
object, as a sibling of the keys already there. Then Publish.
It should end up looking like this:
"rules": {
"movieNight": { ...your existing rules, untouched... },
"attractions": { ...your existing rules, untouched... },
"jawaiTrip": { ...paste the block below here... }
Delete this ___README___ key when you paste - it is documentation only.
One-time setup afterwards: add your own account's UID under
jawaiTrip/admins/<uid> with the value true, from the console's Data tab.
Nobody can grant themselves admin, so the first one is added by hand.
Your UID is shown on the /admin page when you are signed in but not yet
an admin.
No .indexOn entries are needed: every read here is a direct key lookup
or a whole-node read by an admin, never an orderByChild query.

$bookingId..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('bookerUid').val() === auth.uid) || (data.exists() && data.child('bookerUid').val() === auth.uid && data.child('status').val() !== 'CONFIRMED') || root.child('jawaiTrip/admins').child(auth.uid).val() === true)

status..validate: newData.isString() && (((newData.val() === 'AWAITING_PAYMENT' || newData.val() === 'PENDING_VERIFICATION') && (newData.parent().child('bookerUid').val() === auth.uid || root.child('jawaiTrip/admins').child(auth.uid).val() === true)) || ((newData.val() === 'CONFIRMED' || newData.val() === 'REJECTED' || newData.val() === 'CANCELLED') && root.child('jawaiTrip/admins').child(auth.uid).val() === true))
